enchantments.tooltip: Insightful Wisdom +6: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +6 Insight bonus to Wisdom.
Exceptional Prudent Skills Bonus: +10 Exceptional bonus to Heal, Listen and Spot.
Reflex Save +13: This item gives a +13 Resistance bonus to your Reflex saves.
Speed +30%: +30% enhancement bonus to movement speed, 15% bonus to attack speed.
Freedom of Movement: This item grants its wearer the ability to move and attack normally while under the influence of magic that impedes movement, such as paralysis, solid fog, slow and web.
